decisions.reason: The hub already routes visitors to individual locations; template reuse and future location-page addition do not necessarily change that routing behavior.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing consistent branding across current and future location sites; no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate already records the same-message visual direction for the master site and location pages; reusable onboarding does not alter those design attributes.
The reusable location-template decision does not change the specified master-site domain.
The source decision concerns reusable location-site structure and does not change the Wix Bookings platform requirement.
Adding future location sites without redesign does not modify the existing per-location booking, revenue, sales, calendar, or management-isolation rules.
